$Comment: The game's own Halloween Broomstick, a staff no recipe or drop hands out, so the stall is where players find one. Open to everyone and priced well above the basics, so a season's spare sweets have somewhere to go. The title is the item's own name key, written in full (server.items.<Id>.name) so the stall shows the name the item shows in the bag; the item has no description key, so the offer has no line under it.
